api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Workers: List Workers

api_arguments.q: string: Query condition to filter workers. Supports standard Oracle REST query syntax. Example: q=PersonNumber='12345' or q=BusinessTitle like 'Manager%'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Example: fields=PersonId,PersonNumber,DisplayName,PrimaryEmailAddress
api_arguments.expand: string: Comma-separated list of child resources to include in the response. Valid values: assignments, emails, phones, addresses, names, visas, citizenships, legislativeInfo
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses links in the response payload.
api_arguments.offset: integer: Starting position in the result set. Default is 0.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum number of records to return. Default is 25, maximum is 500.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes a count of total matching records in the response.
api_arguments.orderBy: string: Field to sort results by. Example: orderBy=PersonNumber:asc

functionality: Retrieves a list of workers. Supports filtering by query parameters and expanding related resources like assignments and contact details.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Workers: Get a Worker

api_arguments.PersonId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the person (worker).
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.
api_arguments.expand: string: Comma-separated child resources to include. Valid values: assignments, emails, phones, addresses, names, visas, citizenships, legislativeInfo, workRelationships
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses links in the response payload.

functionality: Retrieves details of a specific worker by PersonId, including personal information and optionally expanded related resources.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Workers: Get Worker Assignments

api_arguments.PersonId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the person.
api_arguments.WorkerNumber: [REQUIRED] string: The worker number identifying the work relationship.
api_arguments.effectiveDate: string: Date for which assignment details are retrieved. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to current date.
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: gradeLadders, workMeasures, managers
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses links in the response payload.

functionality: Retrieves all assignments for a worker under a specific work relationship, including job, grade, position, department, and location details.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Workers: Create a Worker

api_arguments.LastName: [REQUIRED] string: Last name of the worker.
api_arguments.FirstName: string: First name of the worker.
api_arguments.DateOfBirth: string: Date of birth of the worker. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.LegislationCode: [REQUIRED] string: Legislation code of the country. Example: US
api_arguments.PersonNumber: string: Unique person number. If not provided, system generates one.
api_arguments.StartDate: [REQUIRED] string: Employment start date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.WorkerType: [REQUIRED] string: Type of worker. Valid values: E (Employee), C (Contingent Worker).
api_arguments.BusinessUnitId: [REQUIRED] integer: Identifier of the business unit the worker belongs to.
api_arguments.LegalEntityId: [REQUIRED] integer: Identifier of the legal entity.
api_arguments.JobId: integer: Identifier of the job associated with the assignment.
api_arguments.LocationId: integer: Identifier of the work location.
api_arguments.ReportsTo: integer: PersonId of the manager this worker reports to.

functionality: Creates a new worker record including personal information and initial employment details.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Workers: Update a Worker

api_arguments.PersonId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the person to update.
api_arguments.DateOfBirth: string: Updated date of birth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.BloodType: string: Blood type of the worker.
api_arguments.MaritalStatus: string: Marital status. Valid values: M (Married), S (Single), D (Divorced), W (Widowed).
api_arguments.MaritalStatusDate: string: Date of marital status change. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

functionality: Updates personal information of an existing worker. Assignment and employment data require updating through work relationship and assignment child resources.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Absences: List Absence Records

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Example: q=PersonNumber='100020' to retrieve absences for a specific employee.
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated fields to include in the response.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid value: absenceDates
api_arguments.offset: integer: Starting record position. Default is 0.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Number of records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns the total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links from the response.

functionality: Retrieves a list of absence records across all employees. Filter using the q parameter to scope to a specific employee or date range.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Absences: Create an Absence

api_arguments.PersonNumber: [REQUIRED] string: Employee person number for whom the absence is being created.
api_arguments.AbsenceTypeId: [REQUIRED] integer: Identifier of the absence type (e.g., Annual Leave, Sick Leave).
api_arguments.StartDate: [REQUIRED] string: Start date of the absence. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.EndDate: string: End date of the absence. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Required if absence type does not support open-ended absences.
api_arguments.StartDateDuration: number: Duration of the first day. Use when partial days are applicable (e.g., 0.5 for half day).
api_arguments.EndDateDuration: number: Duration of the last day. Use when partial days are applicable.
api_arguments.Approved: boolean: If true, marks the absence as approved directly. Requires appropriate privileges.
api_arguments.Comments: string: Optional comments or reason for the absence.

functionality: Creates a new absence record for an employee. Supports full-day and partial-day absences.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Absences: Delete an Absence

api_arguments.AbsenceEntryId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the absence record to delete.

functionality: Deletes an existing absence record. The absence must be in a status that allows deletion (e.g., not already approved or processed in payroll).

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Jobs: List Jobs

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition for jobs. Supports filtering by JobCode, Name, JobFamilyId, ActiveStatus. Example: q=ActiveStatus='A'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: grades, evaluationCriteria
api_arguments.offset: integer: Starting record position. Default is 0.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Number of records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: Suppresses HATEOAS links if true.
api_arguments.effectiveDate: string: Effective date for date-effective records. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

functionality: Retrieves a list of job definitions. Jobs define the role and responsibilities associated with a position or assignment.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Positions: List Positions

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports PositionCode, Name, DepartmentId, LocationId, JobId, ActiveStatus. Example: q=ActiveStatus='A' and DepartmentId=300000001234567
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated fields to include in the response.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: incumbents, evaluationCriteria
api_arguments.offset: integer: Starting position in result set. Default is 0.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total record count in response.
api_arguments.effectiveDate: string: Date for which position data is retrieved. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves a list of positions. Positions are specific instances of a job within an organization structure, optionally tied to a department and location.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Departments: List Departments

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition for departments. Supports Name, DepartmentId, OrganizationId, EffectiveStartDate, Status. Example: q=Status='A'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.
api_arguments.offset: integer: Starting record offset. Default is 0.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Number of records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count of matching records.
api_arguments.effectiveDate: string: Effective date for date-tracked department data. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links from the response.

functionality: Retrieves a list of departments in the organization hierarchy.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Grades: List Grades

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports GradeCode, Name, SetId, ActiveStatus. Example: q=ActiveStatus='A'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated fields to return in the response.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid value: gradeSteps
api_arguments.offset: integer: Starting position in result set. Default is 0.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total count of records.
api_arguments.effectiveDate: string: Effective date for date-effective grade data. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: Suppresses HATEOAS links if true.

functionality: Retrieves a list of grades used in compensation and assignment structures.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Locations: List Locations

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports LocationCode, LocationName, ActiveStatus, Country. Example: q=Country='US' and ActiveStatus='A'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated fields to return.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total record count.
api_arguments.effectiveDate: string: Effective date for location data. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves a list of work locations, including address and geographic details.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Person Email Addresses: Get Worker Emails

api_arguments.PersonId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the worker.
api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Example: q=EmailType='W1' to retrieve work emails only.
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves all email addresses associated with a worker. Supports filtering by email type (e.g., work, personal).

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Person Phone Numbers: Get Worker Phones

api_arguments.PersonId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the worker.
api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Example: q=PhoneType='W1' to retrieve work phones only.
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves all phone numbers associated with a worker, including work, mobile, and home numbers.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Payroll Elements: List Payroll Elements

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports ElementName, ElementClassification, LegislativeDataGroupId, ProcessingType. Example: q=ElementClassification='Earnings'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: inputValues, eligibilityRules
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.effectiveDate: string: Effective date for element data. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves payroll elements such as earnings, deductions, and benefits used in payroll processing.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Element Entries: List Element Entries for a Worker

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports PersonId, AssignmentId, ElementName, EntryType, EffectiveStartDate. Example: q=PersonId=300000001234567
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated fields to include in the response.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid value: entryValues
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total count.
api_arguments.effectiveDate: string: Effective date for date-effective element entries. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves element entries (earnings, deductions, benefits) assigned to a worker's payroll. Filter by PersonId or AssignmentId to scope results.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Element Entries: Create an Element Entry

api_arguments.AssignmentId: [REQUIRED] integer: The assignment identifier for the worker.
api_arguments.ElementId: [REQUIRED] integer: Identifier of the payroll element to attach.
api_arguments.EntryType: [REQUIRED] string: Type of element entry. Valid values: E (Recurring), A (Additional), S (Override), D (Additive).
api_arguments.EffectiveStartDate: [REQUIRED] string: Start date of the element entry. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.EffectiveEndDate: string: End date of the element entry. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to end of time if not provided.
api_arguments.entryValues: array: Input values for the element entry. Each object contains InputValueId and ScreenEntryValue. Example: [{"InputValueId": 300000001, "ScreenEntryValue": "5000"}]

functionality: Creates a new element entry to assign a payroll element (such as a bonus, deduction, or benefit) to a worker's assignment.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Person Legislative Data: Get Legislative Information

api_arguments.PersonId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the worker.
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.
api_arguments.effectiveDate: string: Effective date for legislative data. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

functionality: Retrieves country-specific legislative information for a worker, such as tax identification, social security number, and statutory details based on the worker's legislation code.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Work Relationships: Terminate a Work Relationship

api_arguments.PersonId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the person.
api_arguments.WorkerNumber: [REQUIRED] string: The worker number identifying the specific work relationship.
api_arguments.TerminationType: [REQUIRED] string: Reason for termination. Lookup type: TERMINATION_REASON. Example: 'RESIGNATION', 'INVOLUNTARY'.
api_arguments.ActualTerminationDate: [REQUIRED] string: Date on which the employment terminates. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.LastWorkingDate: string: Last date the worker is physically at work. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to ActualTerminationDate if not provided.
api_arguments.NotifiedTerminationDate: string: Date the termination was communicated. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.Comments: string: Additional comments or notes about the termination.
api_arguments.RehireRecommendation: string: Rehire eligibility. Valid values: Y (Yes), N (No).

functionality: Terminates an employee's work relationship by recording the termination reason, date, and related details.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Performance Documents: List Performance Documents

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports PersonId, PerformancePeriodId, Status, TemplateId. Example: q=PersonId=300000001234567 and Status='IN_PROGRESS'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated fields to return.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: goals, feedbackRequests, ratings
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves performance documents for employees. Filter by person and performance period to retrieve specific review cycles.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Goals: List Worker Goals

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports PersonId, GoalPlanId, Status, GoalType. Example: q=PersonId=300000001234567 and Status='ACTIVE'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated fields to return.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: keyResults, targetOutcomes
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves performance goals assigned to workers. Filter by person, goal plan, or status to narrow results.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Learning Records: List Worker Learning Records

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports LearnerPersonId, CourseId, OfferingId, Status, CompletionDate. Example: q=LearnerPersonId=300000001234567
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated fields to return.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves learning enrollment and completion records for workers. Used to track training compliance and course completions.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Requisitions: List Job Requisitions

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports RequisitionId, Title, Status, RecruitingTypeCode, BusinessUnitId. Example: q=Status='OPEN'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated fields to include in the response.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: hiringTeam, jobApplications
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves job requisitions created in Oracle Recruiting Cloud. Use Status filter to list open, closed, or draft requisitions.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Job Applications: List Applications for a Requisition

api_arguments.RequisitionId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the job requisition.
api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports Status, CandidateId, Phase. Example: q=Phase='OFFER'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated fields to return.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: candidate, offers, interviews
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves all job applications submitted for a specific requisition, including candidate details and current phase.

api_name: REST API for Oracle HCM Cloud - Compensation Plans: List Compensation Plans

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports PlanName, Status, PlanType. Example: q=Status='Active'
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated fields to return.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: components, eligibilityRules
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total record count.
api_arguments.effectiveDate: string: Effective date for date-effective plan data. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves compensation plans defined in Oracle Compensation Cloud, including salary, bonus, and stock plans.
